a.lede: Minister for public service says the devices pose ‘legitimate privacy and security concerns’ in commonwealth-run workplaces The Albanese government is considering a “world-leading” ban on smart glasses in its offices and service centres as councils around Australia push the technology out of public spaces over privacy fears. The government has avoided a sweeping ban on the import of the camera-equipped
a.title: Albanese government considers ‘world-leading’ ban on smart glasses in public offices and buildings

b.lede: As Australia considers barring the use of smart glasses in government offices, the BBC asks people in Sydney what they think.
b.title: Would Australians support a smart glasses ban?
